creation_purpose: Opt-in configuration-only adoption of semantically compatible Phase 2A-2C candidates.
candidate_count_note: The primary bundle includes seven conceptual candidates and eight configuration-field assignments; ETH and BTC target_debt_share assignments are one conceptual candidate.
sensitivity_scope_note: The low/high sensitivity YAML files are bounded population-and-debt-share sensitivity bundles only. Confidence-threshold sensitivity remains deferred because the candidate audit did not establish complete numerical ranges for those fields.
normal_liquidatable_share_note: max_normal_liquidatable_share remains 0.0. Future sensitivity must check its interaction with n_vaults because the smallest positive observed share is 1 / n_vaults.
legacy_default_preservation: Default experiment factories and Experiments 1-5 remain unchanged. The empirical profile is selected only by explicitly loading config/profiles/empirical.yaml.
